name: spellkave_link_places
label: Link Places
description: Author a portal between two existing place_nodes (same graph or cross-graph). Writes place_edges with place_graph_id "" when graphs differ (Stonehill pattern), sets substrate_crossing automatically for outdoor↔indoor. Does NOT attach a place_edge_affordance by default (ADR-0101): an ordinary edge just inherits the bundle/graph movement_default (spellkave_set_movement_default) via place_edges.inherit_movement_default, which defaults to true — zero per-edge rows for ordinary walking. Pass portal:true (+ affordance_template_id / bindings_json) only for a special affordance you want attached to THIS edge at creation time; spellkave_bind_edge_affordance is the preferred (FK-validated) path for that, including after the edge already exists. Use after spellkave_author_place on both sides.

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on generated edges. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle`.

from.description: Fully-qualified place_node id (must already exist in workspace/target).

to.description: Fully-qualified place_node id (must already exist in workspace/target).

substrate_crossing.description: Force substrate_crossing. Omit to auto: true when the two nodes' substrates differ, or when they belong to different place_graphs (cross-graph portal).

portal.description: Attach a place_edge_affordance on each edge (default FALSE, ADR-0101 — ordinary edges inherit the bundle/graph movement_default instead, no per-edge row needed). Pass true only to attach a special affordance right at creation time; template defaults to core/affordance/traverse_open_portal unless affordance_template_id is set.

affordance_template_id.description: place_edge_affordance.affordance_template_id when portal is true (portal defaults to false — see that field). Default "core/affordance/traverse_open_portal" when portal is true and this is omitted. Self-sufficient packs pass e.g. "srd/affordance/step".

bindings_json.description: place_edge_affordance.bindings_json when portal is true (default ""). e.g. '{"movement_reach_resource":"srd/speed-walk","long_running_move_session":"srd/long_running_move"}' for srd Step.

door.description: If true, attach metadata namespace place.door on each edge_key (inert; locks later).

cell_anchor.description: H3 res10 cell anchor as decimal u64 string for substrate_crossing edges (MF-VAL-102). Omit to use dummy 1 (legacy); outdoor portals should pass a real cell.

promptSnippet: Link two place nodes with a walkable portal (cross-graph OK)
promptGuidelines: Both from/to node ids must already exist (author_place first).
Cross-graph links leave place_graph_id empty; outdoor↔indoor sets substrate_crossing=true.
door:true only stamps metadata — no lock/secret mechanics yet (E prep).
ADR-0101: ordinary walking needs NO affordance row here — author one spellkave_set_movement_default per bundle/graph instead, once.

portal:true is the exception path — a special per-edge affordance right at creation time (e.g. a template that differs from the bundle default). For an edge that already exists, prefer spellkave_bind_edge_affordance (FK-validated).
